nodes.label: login_attempts rule (sliding_window, strict, fail_closed)
nodes.rationale: Low volume, high accuracy: bypass leasing.

nodes.label: gRPC callback API (CheckCallback, never block)
nodes.rationale: Never block a gRPC thread; slow work completes via CheckCallback.

nodes.label: Strict vs leased mode comparison across chunk sizes
nodes.norm_label: strict vs leased mode comparison across chunk sizes

nodes.label: Accuracy bound: over-admission = instances x chunk size
nodes.norm_label: accuracy bound: over-admission = instances x chunk size

nodes.label: Architecture pipeline: gRPC server -> lease manager -> Redis batcher -> Redis Cluster
nodes.norm_label: architecture pipeline: grpc server -> lease manager -> redis batcher -> redis cluster

nodes.label: Redis data model ({key}:tb, {key}:sw hash tags, PEXPIRE, Redis TIME)
nodes.norm_label: redis data model ({key}:tb, {key}:sw hash tags, pexpire, redis time)
nodes.rationale: Hash tags keep each key in one cluster slot; Redis TIME as single time source.

nodes.label: Failure modes (Redis down, failover, MOVED/ASK, NOSCRIPT, crash)
nodes.norm_label: failure modes (redis down, failover, moved/ask, noscript, crash)

nodes.label: Lease manager (local fast path)
nodes.rationale: Sharded cache-line-aligned map, atomics only, single-flight refill, adaptive chunk size capped at fraction of global limit.

nodes.label: RedisBackend abstraction and cluster client
nodes.rationale: redis-plus-plus async cluster chosen in Day 3 spike, fallback hiredis+libuv; SCRIPT LOAD at startup, EVALSHA, retry on NOSCRIPT.

nodes.label: Reliability layer (circuit breaker, backpressure, fail policy)
nodes.norm_label: reliability layer (circuit breaker, backpressure, fail policy)

nodes.label: Lua script tests against real Redis
nodes.norm_label: lua script tests against real redis

nodes.label: Cache-line aligned per-shard data
nodes.rationale: alignas(64) avoids false sharing between shards.

nodes.label: Hot path rules: no mutex, no heap alloc, no per-request logging
nodes.norm_label: hot path rules: no mutex, no heap alloc, no per-request logging
nodes.rationale: Check served from a local lease must hit latency targets; use per-shard spinlocks/atomics, string_view and pooled objects instead.

nodes.label: Explicit atomic memory order justification
nodes.rationale: Default acquire/release; relaxed and seq_cst must be justified in a comment.

nodes.label: Benchmark methodology (5 runs, medians, release builds only, open vs closed loop)
nodes.norm_label: benchmark methodology (5 runs, medians, release builds only, open vs closed loop)
nodes.rationale: WSL2 and shared machines are noisy; sanitizer builds distort profiles; coordinated omission must be avoided.

nodes.label: Never present extrapolation as measurement
nodes.rationale: Laptop/WSL2 cannot reach 1M req/s; report per-instance/per-core numbers and show extrapolation with assumptions.

nodes.label: Production resilience rules (deadlines, graceful shutdown, cancellation)
nodes.norm_label: production resilience rules (deadlines, graceful shutdown, cancellation)
nodes.rationale: Clients set deadlines; server drains in-flight requests on SIGINT/SIGTERM; handle IsCancelled.

nodes.label: Skill Quality Standards (VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills)
nodes.rationale: Third-person descriptions, progressive disclosure (<100 token frontmatter, <500 line body), no absolute paths, scoped tools.

nodes.label: Strict Layer Decoupling
nodes.rationale: Core algorithms never include gRPC/protobuf headers; transport depends on RateLimiterCore via shared_ptr dependency injection.

nodes.label: Thread safety: fine-grained locking or lock-free atomics
nodes.norm_label: thread safety: fine-grained locking or lock-free atomics
nodes.rationale: Avoid global coarse-grained locks for high-concurrency.

nodes.label: Hybrid design: local token lease + batched Redis Lua refill
nodes.norm_label: hybrid design: local token lease + batched redis lua refill
nodes.rationale: Serving from local atomics avoids a Redis round trip per request to reach 1M Check/s with p99 < 2 ms.
